description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between perplexity and the parameter M (likely representing a pruning or layer configuration variable) for three different models: LLAMA1-7B, LLAMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B. The x-axis, labeled “M,” spans integer values from 3 to 8 with a linear scale and tick marks at each integer. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” ranges from approximately 15.0 to 45.0, also on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 10.0 (20.0, 30.0, 40.0). The LLAMA1-7B model (green line with circle markers) starts at a perplexity of ~28.0 at M=3, dips slightly to ~25.0 at M=5, then rises steadily to ~36.0 at M=8. The LLAMA1-13B model (orange line with star markers) begins at ~20.0 at M=3, decreases to ~16.0 at M=5, remains flat until M=6, then gradually increases to ~21.0 at M=8. The Vicuna-7B model (blue line with triangle markers) starts at ~41.0 at M=3, declines to ~34.0 at M=5, remains relatively stable until M=7, then rises sharply to ~40.0 at M=8. All lines are solid, and the legend in the upper right corner identifies each model by color and marker shape.
